revision_summary: No fabricated quotes were found (deterministic check returned zero failures, and manual spot-check confirms quotes are accurately drawn). Restate the classification and schema_reference accordingly. (2) The 02:12 bill-offer moment is labeled 'enthusiasm_signal,' a classification not defined anywhere in the schema's controlled vocabulary -- relabel using an existing schema-grounded tag such as trust_building_micro_trades or fold it into the bill_anchor_depth directive discussion instead of inventing a new category. Additionally, this call is clearly a repeat-touch/recycled-lead scenario (rep references a prior evaluation and prior conversation), which the schema's context.lead_types_and_bill_collection_rules section explicitly asks Stewart to account for when reading bill-collection effort -- multi_touch_patterns was left empty and should instead note the repeat-touch context and its implications for interpreting the skipped verify/bill steps. These are targeted fixes; the core trajectory read, outcome dispute (tentative vs. booked), and handoff brief are well-supported and should be retained.
